text: The StaticAutoPtr phase resets sConnectorPattern to nullptr and allocates its locale pattern only when the pointer is absent. It copies the stored string before substituting weekday and time placeholders. A present empty string no longer triggers the old IsEmpty retry condition. Keep pointer presence, stored text and explicit reinitialization distinct; this source inspection does not prove locale formatting success, teardown or runtime cache behavior.
title: The date connector cache uses pointer absence rather than empty text as its lazy sentinel
